## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm check`
- [ ] `pnpm exec vitest run`
- [ ] `pnpm run build` (required for code/assets/Docker changes)
- [ ] Docker/self-host flow checked if packaging changed

## Checklist

- [ ] Conventional PR title (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `test:`, `chore:`).
- [ ] Tests added or updated for behavior changes.
- [ ] Docs updated for API/config/setup/deploy/user-visible changes.
- [ ] UI changes follow the style-guide-first rule: new reusable components are shown in `/style-guide` before product use.
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, cookies, `.env`, or local DB files committed.
- [ ] No cloud-only billing/quota/custom-subdomain logic added to OSS core.
